nodes.label: Gauss-Newton (gn) iterative reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Nonlinear iterative solver; best rel_L2_roi among smooth methods (~0.39-0.40) and chi2/dof ~0.77 (fits noise level); captures inclusion location but underestimates contrast and has noisy background oscillations.
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: L1-regularized reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Sparsity-promoting; lowest rel_L1 (0.14-0.17) and clean near-uniform background, highest dice on coarse/medium (~0.60), but compressed dynamic range (~0.56-0.61) and slowest (2-3.4s).
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: Linear one-step (linearized) reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Instant (0.0s) linearized difference solve; worst rel_L2_roi (~0.46) and dice (~0.39-0.41), and chi2/dof 5.4-7.7 indicates underfitting the data.
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: Total Variation (TV) reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Edge-preserving piecewise-constant solutions; best rel_L2_roi (0.37) and highest dynamic range (up to 0.95) but blocky patchy artifacts in background, high rel_L1 (~0.32-0.34).
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: Coarse inverse mesh
nodes.rationale: Large elements limit resolution; TV dice drops to 0.378 on coarse.
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: Edge-refined inverse mesh
nodes.rationale: Refined near electrodes/boundary; gives highest dice for GN (0.612) and TV (0.579).
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)

nodes.label: Medium structured inverse mesh
nodes.rationale: Regular triangulated pattern visible in reconstructions (hexagonal artifacts).
nodes.community_name: Reconstruction quality metrics (rel_L2_roi, rel_L1, dice, dyn.range, chi2/dof)
